heading.en: From 'make it cheap' to 'make it right for society'

hook.en: A company that once said 'customers will buy whatever we make' now prints recycling instructions on every bottle. Business thinking has travelled a long way.
hook.kn: 'ನಾವು ಏನು ತಯಾರಿಸಿದರೂ ಗ್ರಾಹಕರು ಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾರೆ' ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಿದ್ದ ಕಂಪನಿ ಇಂದು ಪ್ರತಿ ಬಾಟಲಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಮರುಬಳಕೆ ಸೂಚನೆ ಮುದ್ರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಚಿಂತನೆ ಬಹಳ ಬದಲಾಗಿದೆ.

body.en: Production concept: customers want products that are available and affordable, so focus on mass production and low cost. Product concept: customers want quality, so focus on product improvement. Selling concept: customers will not buy enough unless persuaded, so focus on aggressive selling and promotion. Marketing concept: identify customer needs and satisfy them better than competitors. Societal marketing concept: satisfy customers while also caring for society's long-term welfare.
body.kn: ಉತ್ಪಾದನಾ ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆ: ಲಭ್ಯತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಬೆಲೆ. ಉತ್ಪನ್ನ ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆ: ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟ. ಮಾರಾಟ ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆ: ಆಕ್ರಮಣಕಾರಿ ಮಾರಾಟ. ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆ: ಗ್ರಾಹಕರ ಅಗತ್ಯ ತೃಪ್ತಿ. ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆ: ಗ್ರಾಹಕ ತೃಪ್ತಿ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಸಮಾಜ ಕಲ್ಯಾಣ.

title.en: On the board: Five marketing philosophies

narration.en: Marketing thinking has moved through five philosophies. Let us compare their focus.

say.en: Marketing thinking has moved through five philosophies. Let us compare their focus.
Production: make it cheap and available. Product: make it better.
Selling: persuade people to buy. Marketing: find needs and satisfy them better than rivals.
Societal marketing adds the welfare of society to customer satisfaction.
Selling starts with the product and wants quick sales; marketing starts with the customer and wants lasting profit.

title.en: Marketing vs selling; functions of marketing

body.en: Selling focuses on the product and the seller's need to convert products into cash; marketing focuses on the customer's needs and aims at long-term profit through customer satisfaction. Selling is only one part of marketing. Functions of marketing: gathering and analysing market information, marketing planning, product designing and development, standardisation and grading, packaging and labelling, branding, customer support services, pricing, promotion, physical distribution, transportation and storage or warehousing.
body.kn: ಮಾರಾಟ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರನ ಅಗತ್ಯದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೇಂದ್ರಿತ; ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ ಗ್ರಾಹಕರ ಅಗತ್ಯದ ಮೇಲೆ. ಮಾರಾಟವು ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆಯ ಒಂದು ಭಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ.

points.en: Standardisation: producing goods of fixed specifications
Grading: classifying products into groups by quality
Customer support: after-sales service, complaints, credit

problem.en: A detergent maker reformulates its powder to be phosphate-free so that it does not pollute lakes, even though customers did not demand it, while still keeping it effective and affordable. Which philosophy is this?

steps.en: The firm still satisfies customers: effective and affordable product.
It also protects lakes, i.e. the long-term welfare of society.
Customer satisfaction plus social welfare is the societal marketing concept.
